Network Atlas

Open a map export made by the Network Atlas: Interactive Map & Stats mod inside Transport Fever 3.

Drop network_atlas_export.lua here
or use the buttons below
From a save:
  1. Enable Network Atlas: Interactive Map & Stats and load your game.
  2. Click Export map → Export map data in the top-left mod buttons.
  3. The file is written to the game's userdata folder — the mod shows the exact path on its status line. Drop that file here.
